verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no explicit mention of a global CDN or edge caching for static assets — docs reference HTTPS/DDoS protection, deploy speed, and functions, but never describe CDN architecture or edge caching mechanics. Community items about DDoS billing hint at scale infrastructure but don't confirm CDN/edge caching delivery. Missing for 10: any documentation or hands-on evidence of global CDN distribution, edge node caching, or cache-control/performance behavior for static assets.
